product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy/SalesMail provides personalized video messaging and tour-intelligence tools for senior-living, home-care, multifamily, real-estate, and other relationship-driven teams to build trust, generate leads, and convert more tours or customers.
product_one_liner.notes: The company announced in January 2026 that HeartLegacy unified its corporate and product brand under SalesMail.

pricing_page.notes: The HeartLegacy homepage now redirects to a rebrand page and does not provide a pricing link or public pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is marketing/news-oriented and does not show at least two qualifying engineering or technical build posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center contains multiple product and training articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role page lists Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist roles, but no qualifying AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, NLP, LLM, applied-scientist, research-scientist, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude and Amazon Transcribe (Amazon Web Services)
model_provider.notes: The privacy policy states that Amazon Transcribe converts Sidekick recordings to text and Anthropic's Claude analyzes them.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal page contains a GDPR statement; it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The company profile says HeartLegacy is unfunded and has raised no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open-role page lists client-success and demand-generation roles, not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account-executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail announced the Sidekick launch on September 16, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership page identifies the current CEO, CCO, and COO; available executive profiles place the identified VP/C-level leaders' starts before the requested 12-month window, and no departure announcement was found.
